sights.n: Joshin Super Kids Land Main Store (Den Den Town)
sights.w: One of Japan's largest model and hobby specialists: five floors of Gundam plastic models (Gunpla), figures and model trains on the Den Den Town strip.
sights.anime: Gundam / Gunpla — Den Den Town's five-floor plastic-model and figure mecca

sights.w: A whole building of character toys, figures, garage kits and Volks' Super Dollfie dolls in Den Den Town; open 11:00–20:00 year-round.
sights.anime: Figures & dolls — Volks (Super Dollfie, garage kits), a Den Den Town hobby anchor

sights.w: Kiddy Land's Kansai flagship (renewed April 2017 with Hankyu Sanbangai): character-specialist corners (Snoopy, Rilakkuma, Miffy and more), nekomart and toy/fancy goods.
sights.anime: Character goods — Kiddy Land, Japan's classic character-toy chain, Kansai flagship

sights.w: Weekly Shōnen Jump's official shop (One Piece, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, Jujutsu Kaisen merch) on Daimaru Shinsaibashi's 9th-floor pop-culture zone beside Pokémon Center Osaka DX.
sights.anime: Weekly Shōnen Jump — the magazine's official store (One Piece, Dragon Ball, JJK)

sights.w: Hometown showroom of Kaiyodo, the Kadoma-based maker of world-famous anime figures: some 10,000 figures and models across 13 zones, beside Kadoma-shi Station. Opened 26 June 2021 on the 3F of Izumiya Kadoma; 10:00–18:00, adults ¥1,000.
sights.anime: Kaiyodo — the figure maker behind Revoltech and countless anime figures; its Kadoma hometown museum

sights.n: Shinsaibashi PARCO Character Floors (Chiikawa Land · Donguri Republic)
sights.w: Shinsaibashi PARCO's 'POP CULTURE SHINSAIBASHI' floors gather character flagships with photo spots — Chiikawa Land (creator Nagano's official shop, 6F), a large Donguri Republic Ghibli store, Kiddy Land and more; directly linked to Shinsaibashi Station.
sights.anime: Chiikawa & Studio Ghibli — Osaka's character-shop floor (Chiikawa Land, Donguri Republic)

sights.w: Bandai's capsule-toy hall — about 1,000 gashapon machines, opened Dec 2020 as the chain's first Kansai store and billed as the region's largest; since March 2023 it trades inside Bandai Namco Cross Store Osaka Umeda, beside the HEP FIVE Ferris wheel.
sights.anime: Gashapon — Bandai's capsule-toy department store, ~1,000 machines of anime/character capsules

sights.address: Amagasaki City Kaimei Building 1F, 2-1-1 Kaimei-cho, Amagasaki, Hyōgo
sights.w: Opened 2024 as Japan's first permanent display of Amako Sōbē's original art for Rakudai Ninja Rantarō — the manga behind NHK's longest-running anime, Nintama Rantarō; 3 min from Hanshin Amagasaki Station, ¥200.
sights.anime: Nintama Rantarō — original manga art by Amagasaki native Amako Sōbē; Anime Tourism 88 (2026)

sights.address: Miyama, Wakayama City, Wakayama (ferry from Kada Port)
sights.w: Four uninhabited islands in the Kitan Strait with overgrown Meiji-era fort ruins, 20 min by ferry from Kada; the real-world model for Hitogashima in Wakayama-born Yoshinori Tanaka's Summer Time Rendering, selected for the 2023 Anime Tourism 88 with Wakayama City.
sights.anime: Summer Time Rendering — model for the series' island Hitogashima; Anime Tourism 88 (2023, Wakayama City)
